title: Meridian before the 11:00 review
context_note: Second-hand report of an informal call with Meridian's PMO; not confirmed in writing by Meridian.
content:
Hi, quick heads-up before 11:00.

I just spoke with Meridian's PMO. They heard there's 'something with credentials' and say their IT is on it and it should be sorted 'by end of week'. I don't know if that means Friday or earlier.

They also said they're expecting us to present go-live as confirmed today – their board pack already says 17 March and they'd rather not change it.

One more thing: I'm not sure whether the certificate issue Infra mentioned is the same thing as the credentials issue or something separate. Meridian's IT contact for both might be the same person, but I couldn't confirm.

Can we talk before the review?
